title: Automate SQL Server DDL Handling
summary: Datastream now provides new configuration options for SQL Server change tables, enabling automated management of capture instances when DDL changes occur. This simplifies handling schema evolution.
details: The `SqlServerChangeTables` schema has been extended with a new `ddlConfig` property. This property references the newly introduced `SqlServerDdlConfig` schema, which includes two key boolean fields: `autoCreateNewCaptureInstanceOnDdl` and `autoDeleteOldCaptureInstance`. These options allow you to automate the creation and deletion of capture instances in response to DDL changes on SQL Server sources, significantly streamlining DDL change management.
